data.name: Prabhanjan
data.gender_notes: Prabhanjan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who can tame or destroy
data.long_meaning: Prabhanjan is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'Prabh' which means 'to tame'. The suffix 'anjan' means 'destroyer'. This name signifies a person who can tame and destroy. It represents power, courage and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is known as Prabhanjan because he can tame and destroy the negative energies.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prabhanjan is a name that embodies the spirit of courage, wisdom and power. It signifies a person who can tame and destroy the negative energies within themselves and around them. It is a name that inspires strength and resilience, and is a reminder of the power that lies within each one of us.
data.etymology: Prabhanjan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who can tame or destroy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prabhanjan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
